note: Hand-picked free full-length courses. Nothing here is written by the app: `npm run courses` fetches each video's real title, channel, length and chapter list from YouTube and writes studio/courses/<id>.json. Only `name`, `track` and `blurb` are ours, and they describe what the video is, never what it says.

courses.name: Networking & the OSI model
courses.blurb: Four hours down the seven layers, with the protocols and the hardware that sit on each one.

courses.name: System design
courses.blurb: One server, then load balancers, caches, CDNs and the API choices that come with them.

courses.name: Databases with SQL

courses.blurb: Processes, threads, scheduling and memory — what the machine is doing under your program.

courses.name: Linux
courses.blurb: The shell, the file system and the permissions model, from a standing start.

courses.name: Design patterns
courses.blurb: The classic patterns in plain English — what each one is for, in language-neutral terms.

courses.name: C
